title: Asynchronous desktop lifecycle correctness
summary: Resolved stale-state and concurrency defects across project loading, DRC execution and desktop/backend integration.

dates.note: Individual implementation dates are not established; the supplied engineering analysis is an October 5, 2026 snapshot.

facts.text: Resolved desktop failures involving corrupt configuration startup, inconsistent checkpoints, stale work across reloads, competing project loads and subscription/observer lifetimes.
Introduced unique DRC request IDs and rejected stale execution after reload so concurrent backend responses update the correct view, with unit and Playwright regressions.
